title: Complete quadratic polar form
statement: For a natural number $n$ and vectors $x,z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, define their complete quadratic polar form by summing $x_i z_j+z_i x_j$ over all coordinate pairs $i<j$, with the sum taken in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
